0022600131.text: The Trail Blazers (2-0, 1-0 on the road, second in the Northwest and fourth in the West) visit the Los Angeles Lakers (2-0, 2-0 at home, first in the Pacific and first in the West) for Portland's third game of the season. Shaedon Sharpe is out after knee surgery, while Branden Carlson (concussion) and Chris Youngblood (ankle soreness) are listed as day-to-day and are game-time decisions. The teams have not met yet this season, but Portland won the 2025-26 season series 2-1 and took their last meeting 132-116 in Portland on January 17, 2026.
